Fix 6e7f360. My round-2 FAIL was the unlocalized derived-assignment event on a BU lead's record. Re-tested on the real stack in EN and AR. (1) My round-2 spec (dg1-r2-web-repairs.spec.ts), run UNCHANGED: its soft assertions (no 'field/value without a translation', no raw 'scoped_assignment.create') now pass, 2/2. (2) A new independent spec with hard assertions (dg1-r3-derived-audit-localized.spec.ts), 2/2. It cross-checks the API (/audit holds scoped_assignment.create with derivedFromAssignmentId for the new record). The trail row's action is the localized label ('Role granted to the creator (carried over from a business-unit assignment)' / 'إسناد دور لمُنشئ السجل (منقول من إسناد على مستوى وحدة العمل)'). Its fields are localized (User, Role, Scope, Effective until, Carried over from assignment), with the user's display name, the role name ('Transformation Lead' / 'قائد التحوّل') and 'Transformation: this transformation'. The whole trail contains no scoped_assignment, transformation.create, camelCase key, JSON, end_to_end, business_unit_id, bare 'TL' or untranslated marker. The direction is rtl in AR and ltr in EN. The only id left is the source assignment's UUID, a technical identifier with no catalogue label, which the F-DG1-005 standard allows. It is LTR-isolated in AR and not marked untranslated. The transformation's own create row stays localized.
